create_local_parallel_executor: create a local parallel executor that submits jobs to a process pool with configurable CPU count
submit_jobs_to_slurm: submit jobs to a SLURM cluster scheduler using the Executor with type slurm and a partition name
run_debug_executor: run a debug executor that executes jobs synchronously on the current machine for testing
create_noop_executor: create a noop executor that returns jobs immediately without executing for configuration validation
wait_on_jobs: wait on a list of submitted jobs and cancel all on the first error encountered
